nva_pt_text.description: Nova Bíblia de Acesso Livre (NVA), pt-BR, MAST-program translation (unfoldingWord Greek NT + Masoretic Hebrew OT). Combined from biblia.publica's 66 per-book JSON files (aggregator; primary host is git.door43.org/alexandre_brazil) into a single array, canonical Protestant order, no other transformation. NOTE: `url` points at the source directory for humans, not a single fetchable file — `sinew.fetch --download` does NOT support re-deriving this source (unlike the other zip/single-file entries); re-run the manual per-book fetch + combine step to refresh it.
